title: Tourist Season, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: A tourist asks Wood to sign the parody. The stick figure. He signs it 'Drift Wood' and hands it back.

panels.composition: Gully's. A TOURIST with a printout of the parody's day one and a pen. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY II.

characters.pose: holding out the parody and a pen

image.prompt: a tourist holding out a printout of a crude stick-figure comic and a pen to a thin man on a shop stool, a three-legged dog, clean ink

panels.composition: Wood taking the pen. The printout. The stick figure, twelve years old, still hovering six inches.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand holding a pen over a printout of a crude stick figure with a helicopter rotor

panels.composition: What he writes across the bottom, in the display face: DRIFT WOOD. And the gull. Nothing else.

image.prompt: close-up of a printout of a stick-figure comic with the words DRIFT WOOD lettered boldly across its bottom and a tiny gull beside them
image.notes: He signs the meme with the strip's name. Letter after.

panels.composition: The tourist reading it, puzzled. Wood back to his pad. The pup asleep. The tourist leaving with a meme signed by the thing it buried.

image.prompt: a puzzled tourist leaving a shop holding a signed printout while a thin man goes back to drawing, a dog asleep, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust
